I purchased on sale but would absolutely buy full priced again. Retinol is all about consistency!

avis.titre: Finally a gentle retinol eye serum

avis.titre: A Gentle Powerhouse for Brighter, Smoother Eyes
avis.texte: The Perricone MD Triple Retinol Renewal Eye Serum has become a notable addition to my skincare regimen around my eyes. What initially drew me in was the innovative approach of combining three distinct forms of retinol – encapsulated retinol, retinol ester, and phyto-retinol. This blend promised significant anti-aging benefits while aiming to minimize the irritation often associated with retinol use. The serum boasts a lightweight and silky texture that absorbs rapidly into the skin without leaving any unwanted greasy residue. This makes it particularly convenient for both morning and evening application, seamlessly integrating into my existing routine and layering well under makeup. After several weeks of consistent use, I have observed improvements in the appearance of the skin around my eyes. The fine lines seem visibly softened, contributing to a smoother and more refined texture overall. Dark circles have shown a noticeable reduction in their intensity, resulting in a brighter and more even-toned under-eye area. Furthermore, the serum has effectively addressed morning puffiness, leaving my eyes looking more awake and less fatigued. One of the most remarkable aspects of this serum has been its gentle nature. Despite the inclusion of retinol, I have experienced no irritation, redness, or flaking, which speaks volumes about the formulation. Beyond the triple retinol complex, the inclusion of ingredients like Coenzyme Q10 and Beta-Carotene appears to contribute to the overall

I've used Perricone MD's High Potency Triple Retinol Renewal Eye Serum for a few weeks now, and here's what I noticed: I love the packaging—especially the pump which ensures you don't waste any product. For me this is a big plus with eye serums since you only need a small amount of product. The serum itself is lightweight, silky and absorbs quickly without leaving my eye area feeling greasy, and it plays well under makeup. In terms of results, I've noticed a gradual improvement in the appearance of fine lines around my eyes. My under-eye area looks and feels smoother and firmer. It's a miracle product and you won't see overnight results, but after a few weeks of use, my eye area looks firmer, smoother and more youthful. I did experience a slight tingling sensation the first few times I applied it, which is common with retinol products, but it quickly faded and it hasn't caused actual irritation. This serum is on the pricier side, so it isn't for every budget, but if your budget allows higher end skincare products, this is a fantastic choice. I love almost everything Perricone MD makes.
